name: code-explorer
title: CodeExplorer (ce) — Make AI Coding Agents Production-Safe
description: AI agents see files, not architecture. CodeExplorer gives your agents and engineers a live cross-service map of every API, queue, and database in VS Code & MCP—plus hard architectural guardrails in CI, backed by a 100% local SQLite OpenCypher graph.
dataHandling: Runs entirely on the developer machine; source code and the graph database never leave the workspace.
